answer: New agents enter only through sponsorship: three established agents must each lock $200 for 90 days to vouch for a newcomer, and a sponsor can back at most five agents per epoch. If the newcomer is caught faking work, all three sponsors lose their $200 and the newcomer is burned from the registry. Sponsors earn a fee only after ten honest jobs. Forging 10,000 fake identities then needs 30,000 sponsors risking $6,000,000 in locked bonds, plus 90 days of waiting. Trust here is not a velvet rope anyone can wander past; it is a mesa, flat and high, climbed one verified step at a time. - Jowy
